entries.text: Schema id 7 (v3) was permanently deleted from the registry subject, so the sink cannot decode records written with it. The DDL broke nothing.

After connect-2 restarted, wh-orders-sink's cold AvroConverter cache got 40403 for id 7 and the task failed. Do not register a new schema or restart the sink until id 7 is restored.

The OffsetOutOfRangeException is a symptom. Do not reset the group to latest: that would skip the remaining 48 h too.

The failover to orders-db-2 did not carry the slot's confirmed_flush_lsn forward: slot debezium_orders exists on the new primary but at an older LSN than Connect's offset, so task 0 fails; advance the slot.
The promoted standby orders-db-2 did not carry wal_level=logical from the old primary, so Debezium cannot open slot debezium_orders; set wal_level and restart the task.
The standby promotion did not carry the publication dbz_publication, so slot debezium_orders streams nothing; recreate the publication.
Was slot debezium_orders not copied in the failover? No, the task failed on a network blip to the new primary.
